notes.subject: ⟨ye⟩
notes.rationale: Bamanankan bɛ wale-daɲɛ 'ye … ye' wajibiya, Heburukan ma a sɔrɔ

notes.subject: ושיא
notes.rationale: Tɔgɔ in sɛbɛnni: שיא (Shewa) walima שוע (Shusha) i n'a fɔ 2Sam 8:17 de ye; bayɛlɛmabagaw bɛ tununen don ni tɔgɔ tilennen ye

notes.subject: sarakalasebaga
notes.rationale: כהן kɔrɔ tiɲɛna ye 'mɔgɔ min bɛ saraka san' ye; 'sarakalasebaga' ye dilanba-daɲɛ min bɔ Bamanankan kɔnɔ

translation: Shewa (Sewa) ye sebenbaga ye; Tsadok (Sadoku) ni Eviyatar (Abiyatara) ye sarakalasebagaw ⟨ye⟩.
